reason: The publisher documentation describes E4 files with a recording start epoch and sampling-frequency header; it does not guarantee per-sample timestamps. The original gap rule must therefore be conditional on timestamp availability.

replacement_timing_rule.if_per_sample_timestamps_exist: Align using the four-channel timestamp intersection; require positive intervals and no interval greater than 1.5 times the within-file median. Do not interpolate across observed gaps.
replacement_timing_rule.if_only_start_epoch_and_rate_headers_exi: Construct the sample grid from the file start epoch, declared sampling rate, and row order. Require nonempty files, valid positive rate metadata, and starts aligned within half a target sample on the common grid. Treat rows as consecutive at the documented rate; sample loss cannot be detected and must be disclosed.
replacement_timing_rule.conversion: ACC m/s^2 to WESAD raw 1/64-g counts: value * 64 / 9.80665; BVP unchanged; EDA in microSiemens unchanged; TEMP Celsius unchanged. Resample deterministically to 32/64/4/4 Hz using scipy.signal.resample_poly, Kaiser beta 5, denominator limit 10000. TEMP 1-to-4 Hz upsampling adds no measured bandwidth.

preflight_eligibility: All four required files must be nonempty; headers/rates/units must meet the fixed contract; candidate windows must be finite. Report every excluded recording. Retain the ≥100 sampled windows/person and ≥10 eligible participants gates. No signal-quality, label, or outcome-based screening.
reason_for_amendment_timing: This amendment was made after a partial compressed transfer but before opening any archive member or reading any signal value; it corrects only the source-format assumption and does not follow outcome inspection.
